zh.title: 台灣民航局舉辦2026航空保安研討會 聚焦韌性與智慧化
zh.summary: 民航局舉辦2026航空保安研討會；聚焦保安韌性智慧化與桃園機場貨運保安
body: 交通部民用航空局於2026年8月14日舉辦「2026航空保安研討會」，邀集產官學界代表共同參與。本次研討會旨在因應全球新型態威脅並提升台灣航空保安實力，聚焦於保安韌性與智慧化等關鍵議題。
研討會圍繞四大主題進行討論，包括全球航空保安韌性、機場保安智慧化、深植保安文化，以及桃園國際機場新貨運園區貨物保安展望。與會代表包含運輸安全委員會、航空警察局、桃園國際機場公司及長榮空儲等單位代表。
民航局局長何淑萍於致詞時表示，航空保安需要主管機關、警察機關與業界緊密結合。她指出，韌性意指事件發生時快速恢復的能力，恢復時間越短代表韌性越強，需要體系中各崗位人員共同努力與設備智慧化精進。

en.title: CAA Taiwan Hosts 2026 Aviation Security Symposium Focusing on Resilience and Smart Technology
en.summary: CAA Taiwan hosted the 2026 Aviation Security Symposium, focusing on security resilience and smart airport technologies.
body: The Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA) of Taiwan hosted the 2026 Aviation Security Symposium on August 14, 2026. The event brought together industry and official representatives to share operational insights, respond to evolving global threats, and strengthen domestic aviation security capabilities.

Discussions focused on four core themes: global aviation security resilience, smart airport security, embedding a strong security culture, and the cargo security outlook for the new cargo park at Taoyuan International Airport. Participants included representatives from the Taiwan Transportation Safety Board, the Aviation Police Bureau, Taoyuan International Airport Corporation, and Evergreen Air Cargo Services.

CAA Director General Ho Shu-ping stated that aviation security requires close coordination between the civil aviation authority, police forces, and industry partners. She emphasized that security resilience refers to the ability to recover rapidly from incidents, requiring ongoing hardware smartification and commitment from personnel across all roles.
